name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_currency_destination_20260803_125654_818196
sql:
/*
Currency destinations + shop redemption details.
Red diamond=10009; premium gem=10206 (event raw value divided by 100).
Only TC is reported for premium-gem shop redemptions: SG did not yet have a
meaningful premium-gem economy during this comparison window.
*/
WITH Cfg AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' ts, DATE '2026-08-02' te, DATE '2026-05-08' ss),
TB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (
  SELECT '新加坡全体' grp,c.u FROM SC c
  UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.u FROM SC c JOIN SA a ON c.u=a.u
),
Currency AS (
  SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(e."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT) sec,
    REDUCE(FILTER(e.a_rst,x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT)=10009 AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE)>TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE)),0.0,(s,x)->s+ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(x.diff AS DOUBLE),0)),s->s) red,
    REDUCE(FILTER(e.a_rst,x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT)=10206 AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE)>TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE)),0.0,(s,x)->s+ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(x.diff AS DOUBLE),0))/100.0,s->s) gem
  FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
  WHERE e."$part_event"='item_change' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.te AS VARCHAR)
    AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(e."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT),
    REDUCE(FILTER(e.a_rst,x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT)=10009 AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE)>TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE)),0.0,(s,x)->s+ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(x.diff AS DOUBLE),0)),s->s),
    REDUCE(FILTER(e.a_rst,x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT)=10206 AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE)>TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE)),0.0,(s,x)->s+ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(x.diff AS DOUBLE),0))/100.0,s->s)
  FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
  WHERE e."$part_event"='item_change' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,c.te),c.ss) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL
),
Actions AS (
  SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(e."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT) sec,
    CASE WHEN e."$part_event"='skill_get' THEN '技能抽卡' WHEN e."$part_event"='Companion_get' THEN '伙伴抽卡' WHEN e."$part_event"='shop_buy' AND e.shop_item[1].shop_id>10000 THEN '晶钻商城' WHEN e."$part_event"='shop_buy' THEN '红钻商城' END destination
  FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
  WHERE e."$part_event" IN ('shop_buy','skill_get','Companion_get') AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.te AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(e."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT),
    CASE WHEN e."$part_event"='skill_get' THEN '技能抽卡' WHEN e."$part_event"='Companion_get' THEN '伙伴抽卡' WHEN e."$part_event"='shop_buy' AND e.shop_item[1].shop_id>10000 THEN '晶钻商城' WHEN e."$part_event"='shop_buy' THEN '红钻商城' END
  FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
  WHERE e."$part_event" IN ('shop_buy','skill_get','Companion_get') AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,c.te),c.ss) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL
),
Joined AS (
  SELECT c.grp,c.aid,c.red,c.gem,COALESCE(a.destination,'其他/未归因') destination
  FROM Currency c LEFT JOIN Actions a ON c.grp=a.grp AND c.aid=a.aid AND c.sec=a.sec
  WHERE c.red>0 OR c.gem>0
),
Summary AS (
  SELECT grp,destination,COUNT(DISTINCT aid) users,ROUND(SUM(red),0) red,ROUND(SUM(gem),2) gem,
    ROUND(100.0*SUM(red)/NULLIF(SUM(SUM(red)) OVER(PARTITION BY grp),0),2) red_pct,
    ROUND(100.0*SUM(gem)/NULLIF(SUM(SUM(gem)) OVER(PARTITION BY grp),0),2) gem_pct
  FROM Joined GROUP BY 1,2
),
Shop AS (
  SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(e."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT) sec,
    CAST(e.shop_item[1].shop_id AS VARCHAR) shop_id,
    COALESCE(dp."product_id@product_name_tc", ARRAY_JOIN(TRANSFORM(e.a_rst,x -> CAST(x.name AS VARCHAR)),'+')) item_name
  FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
  LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52801 dp ON TRY_CAST(e.shop_item[1].shop_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
  WHERE e."$part_event"='shop_buy' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.te AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(e."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT),CAST(e.shop_item[1].shop_id AS VARCHAR),
    COALESCE(dp18."product_id@product_name_tc",dp13."product_id@product_name_tc",ARRAY_JOIN(TRANSFORM(e.a_rst,x -> CAST(x.name AS VARCHAR)),'+'))
  FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
  LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52801 dp18 ON TRY_CAST(e.shop_item[1].shop_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(dp18."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
  LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_13_0_20639 dp13 ON TRY_CAST(e.shop_item[1].shop_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(dp13."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
  WHERE e."$part_event"='shop_buy' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,c.te),c.ss) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL
),
ShopAgg AS (
  SELECT s.grp,s.shop_id,s.item_name,COUNT(DISTINCT s.aid) users,COUNT(*) times,ROUND(SUM(c.red),0) red,ROUND(SUM(c.gem),2) gem
  FROM Shop s JOIN Currency c ON s.grp=c.grp AND s.aid=c.aid AND s.sec=c.sec
  WHERE c.red>0 OR c.gem>0 GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT 'summary' "数据模块",grp "对比组",destination "对象",NULL "商店ID",NULL "兑换名称",users "消耗人数",NULL "兑换次数",red "消耗红钻",gem "消耗晶钻",red_pct "红钻消耗占比(%)",gem_pct "晶钻消耗占比(%)" FROM Summary
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE WHEN red>0 THEN 'red_shop_detail' ELSE 'gem_shop_detail' END,grp,CASE WHEN red>0 THEN '红钻商城' ELSE '晶钻商城' END,shop_id,item_name,users,times,red,gem,NULL,NULL FROM ShopAgg
WHERE red>0 OR (gem>0 AND grp='繁体CBT')
ORDER BY 1,2,8 DESC,9 DESC;
